summary: Verified the prior run's reactory-azure documentation against the ticket and the live source, and closed the remaining gaps. The deliverable is complete: a 1,005-line page at 06-modules/reactory-azure/README.md with all eleven required areas, a licence reconciliation (MIT / example-only authoritative; 'commercial' in three registry files recorded as the defect), a ten-step worked example mapped to real files and lines, and a 105-citation evidence index that resolves. Cross-links exist from PLATFORM.md §5 (the module-system architecture page), 08-contributing/module-doc-template.md (which names the page the canonical sample implementation), and the regenerated module index. This run independently re-read the module source and confirmed every load-bearing claim (FQN, licence, method counts, Graph defects, sendEmail control flow, storage scaffold, empty services/workflows, package dependencies). All azure checks pass 34/34 and reactor 11/11; the single docs 25/26 failure is the pre-existing stale 07-reference/modules/reactory-core.md on master, byte-identical here. Two closeout actions were taken: the PR body was completed with the change table and verification evidence, and the one item the docs-only branch could not fix at source (the server registry licence) was routed as follow-up ticket REACTORY-302016408/20261019/923623068.
